reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: In src/lib.rs, the library root declares modules and dependencies but defines no runtime owner, raw object, initializer function or mutable static.
owner_creation.invariant: No application allocation is owned by the root file.

aliases_escapes.analysis: In src/lib.rs, public module visibility exposes named APIs without creating new data aliases in this file; raw alias contracts belong to those module entries.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Module declarations are not ownership transfers.

callback_targets.analysis: In src/lib.rs, macro_use c2rust_bitfields enables compile-time derives; the root installs no runtime callback and has no indirect call expression.
callback_targets.invariant: Macro import does not register an application callback.

invalidation.analysis: In src/lib.rs, fault is feature-gated, runtime private and the other modules exported; changing visibility creates no transient pointee lifetime here.
invalidation.invariant: Root declarations retain no borrowed runtime address.

mutation_commit.analysis: In src/lib.rs, the module graph is a compile-time selection; no sequence of partial heap-owner updates occurs during root evaluation.
mutation_commit.invariant: Library declarations have no partial runtime commit.

release_pair.analysis: In src/lib.rs, there is no constructor, destructor or native handle release in the root; module owners remain responsible for their own resources.
release_pair.invariant: Root review cannot stand in for module release review.

error_cleanup.analysis: In src/lib.rs, compilation errors reject the selected module graph; this root supplies no fallible runtime branch that could abandon an owner.
error_cleanup.invariant: Build failure cannot leave a root-owned runtime object.

signals_handoff.analysis: In src/lib.rs, the private runtime declaration does not itself install handlers; remaining translated modules retain their separate signal and ownership obligations.
signals_handoff.invariant: Root visibility does not approve asynchronous module use.
limitations: This review covers only root-file sites. It neither approves the transitive translated modules nor links the isolated safe_core tree.
